description: Choose what to collect from Hacker News: live feeds, historical front pages, search results, specific items or users, or the monthly Who is hiring? threads.

author.description: Only return content written by this Hacker News username.
author.title: Author (mode=search)

commentAuthorFilter.description: Only keep comments written by these usernames. Matching is case-insensitive and accepts partial names.
commentAuthorFilter.title: Comment author filter

commentSort.description: `rank` keeps Hacker News display order. `newest` orders sibling replies newest first.
commentSort.title: Comment order

contentTypes.description: Which Hacker News record types search should return. Selecting several types returns any of them. `front_page` covers only the current front page.
contentTypes.title: Search content types

dateRangeFrom.description: Drop items posted before this date (UTC, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty means no lower bound.
dateRangeFrom.title: Date range from

dateRangeTo.description: Drop items posted after this date (UTC, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty means no upper bound.
dateRangeTo.title: Date range to

domainAllowlist.description: Keep only stories whose link host contains one of these text fragments. For example, `github.com` or `arxiv.org`.
domainAllowlist.title: Domain allowlist

domainBlocklist.description: Drop stories whose link host contains one of these text fragments. For example, `twitter.com` or `x.com`.
domainBlocklist.title: Domain blocklist

enableCommentHierarchy.description: When true, each story carries a nested `comments` tree. When false, comments are separate rows and never contain duplicate reply rows.
enableCommentHierarchy.title: Nest comment replies

excludeDeadOrDeleted.description: Drop items marked dead or deleted by Hacker News. Turning this off uses the slower exact comment path so those records can be included.
excludeDeadOrDeleted.title: Exclude dead or deleted content

exhaustiveSearch.description: Hacker News search exposes at most 1,000 hits per query. When enabled, the actor splits the requested date range into smaller windows so deeper result sets can be collected. Relevance order then follows each date window rather than one global ranking.
exhaustiveSearch.title: Search past 1,000 results

frontPageDate.description: Historical day to read in mode `frontPage`, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Empty uses yesterday (UTC).
frontPageDate.title: Front page date

hiringKeywords.description: Keep only job posts whose text, company, role, location, or tech stack contains one of these terms.
hiringKeywords.title: Hiring keywords

hiringMonths.description: How many recent monthly Who is hiring? threads to parse. Ignored when specific thread IDs are supplied.
hiringMonths.title: Hiring months

hiringThreadIds.description: Specific Who is hiring? thread IDs to parse. Overrides the automatic monthly selection.
hiringThreadIds.title: Hiring thread IDs

includeAuthorProfiles.description: Add `authorKarma` and `authorCreatedAt` to stories and comments. This costs one extra lookup per unique author.
includeAuthorProfiles.title: Add author karma

includeSubmissions.description: For mode `user`, also emit the user's recent stories and comments as normal records after the profile.
includeSubmissions.title: Include user submissions

itemIds.description: Hacker News item IDs to look up, as numbers or numeric strings. Stories, comments, jobs, polls, and poll options are all accepted.
itemIds.title: Item IDs (mode=item)

maxComments.description: How many comments to collect for each story. 0 skips comment collection. This is applied after a story passes your filters.
maxComments.title: Comments per story

maxDepth.description: Deepest reply level to keep when comments are collected. Root comments are depth 0.
maxDepth.title: Maximum reply depth

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records across all types. Nested comments also count toward this cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

minCommentCount.description: Drop stories and polls with fewer than this many comments.
minCommentCount.title: Minimum comment count

minScore.description: Drop stories, jobs, and polls below this point score. Comments are unaffected because Hacker News does not publish comment scores.
minScore.title: Minimum points

mode.description: What to scrape. Feeds walk the live Hacker News lists. `item` looks up specific IDs, `user` loads profiles, `search` queries Hacker News history, `frontPage` reads a historical day, and `whoIsHiring` parses monthly hiring threads.
mode.title: Mode

remoteOnly.description: Keep only hiring posts that explicitly mention remote work.
remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only

searchQueries.description: One or more keyword queries. Every query runs independently and the results are merged without duplicates. Leave empty to browse by tags, author, or story instead.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

searchSort.description: `relevance` ranks by keyword match. `date` returns newest first and is more reproducible.
searchSort.title: Search order

startUrls.description: Hacker News links to read directly: item, user, historical front-page, and hiring-thread URLs. IDs and URLs are merged with the mode-specific lists.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

storyId.description: Only return content attached to this story ID. Useful with `contentTypes` set to `comment` to search inside one thread.
storyId.title: Story ID (mode=search)

submissionTypes.description: Which submissions to emit when `includeSubmissions` is enabled.
submissionTypes.title: User submission types

usernames.description: Hacker News usernames whose profiles and, optionally, submissions you want.
usernames.title: Usernames (mode=user)

title: Hacker News Scraper Input
